title: evidence-ce (v2.12)
description: Change-Indication Evidence. Issued when an RDP performs an envelope/metadata transformation needed for sending or receiving the data (Regulation (EU) No 910/2014, Article 44(1)(e)). End-to-end encryption forbids content transformation; only envelope/metadata transformations are permitted, and each such change MUST be evidenced and indicated to both the sender and the addressee.

event.description: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014, Article 44(1)(e) change of data. No dedicated ETSI EN 319 522-1 clause 6 event exists for this; it is carried as a profile extension (EN 319 522-2 component E01).

transformation.description: X-24 (evidence 2.5): the OBSERVABLE envelope/metadata transformation performed. Content (plaintext) transformation is forbidden under E2EE. The former epoch-change value is REMOVED: MLS epoch changes do not re-encrypt queued application messages and intermediaries cannot transform the E2EE envelope — the operation was unobservable by its stated issuer; a sender resubmission after an epoch change is a NEW submission chain (new SE), never a CE.

envelope_hash_before.description: X-24 (evidence 2.5): the transmitted-octet commitment of the INPUT envelope — the SE's envelope_hash for this message (LINT-CE-01 chains it). The RDP legitimately observes these ciphertext framing bytes.

envelope_hash_after.description: REQUIRED for re-packaging: the commitment of the OUTPUT envelope.

part_envelope_hashes.description: REQUIRED for chunking: one commitment per emitted part.
